root_cause.summary: Fact source binding was still a monolithic section of ContractDrivenPerceptionService.compile: it built AttributeObservation rows, EvidenceSet records and semantic coverage without internal stage checkpoints, so a public stall could only be reported as PERCEPTION_FACT_SOURCE_BINDING_STALLED.
proven_by: ContractDrivenPerceptionService.compile called attribute_observations, evidence_set, semantic_coverage and semantic_coverage_report between before_fact_source_binding and after_fact_source_binding.
R2.13 public trace reached before_fact_source_binding and did not reach after_fact_source_binding.
R2.13 top-level TaskRunResult.reason_code was absent while validation/completion/events carried the blocking reason, creating canonical runtime truth inconsistency.

source_binding_subresponsibilities.source_index_build: requirements, capability decisions, capabilities and execution evidence indexes
source_binding_subresponsibilities.attribute_observation_projection: selected entities plus expected attributes become AttributeObservation states
source_binding_subresponsibilities.evidence_ref_resolution: evidence refs are counted and deduplicated as refs, not hydrated into event payloads
source_binding_subresponsibilities.evidence_set_materialization: observed AttributeObservation records become EvidenceRecord rows; missing/unsupported records are not promoted
source_binding_subresponsibilities.source_provenance_binding: semantic coverage and coverage report bind provenance and limitations
source_binding_subresponsibilities.source_binding_bound_check: generic bounds decide explicit block reason without silent truncation

questions_answered.which_method_implements_source_binding: ContractDrivenPerceptionService.compile orchestrates the section; attribute_observations and evidence_set perform the heavy projections.
questions_answered.attribute_observations_boundary: Before R2.14 it had no internal runtime checkpoint and scanned requirements/decisions from local lists before each projection.
questions_answered.evidence_set_boundary: Before R2.14 it materialized observed evidence records without a separate bounded checkpoint in the public trace.
questions_answered.terminal_reason_projection_gap: TaskRunResult.reason_code was null in R2.13; endpoints inferred from validation/completion/events.

o_n_squared_source_lookup.evidence: R2.14 introduces precomputed requirement, decision, capability and execution-evidence indexes before projection.

excessive_attribute_observation_cardinal.evidence: Public input cardinality was 2230 projected entities and expected attributes multiply into AttributeObservation attempts.

evidence_copy_explosion.evidence: EvidenceSet materialization copied observed records; R2.14 adds metrics and checkpoints to prove or refute at runtime.

truth_promotion_leakage.evidence: Observed/derived/candidate semantics and truth_eligible gating already had generic fixture tests.

filesystem_observation_leakage.evidence: No filesystem observer call was found in source binding; compile_only remains active.

patch_plan: Add generic source-binding subcheckpoints between before_fact_source_binding and after_fact_source_binding.
Use indexes for requirements, decisions, capabilities and execution evidence.
Emit bounded progress checkpoints for AttributeObservation projection and EvidenceSet materialization.
Persist top-level TaskRunResult.reason_code for terminal non-success results.
Add generic fixture tests and public rerun collectors.
